name: helm
readme_excerpt: Helm Helm is a tool for managing Charts. Charts are packages of pre-configured Kubernetes resources. Use Helm to: - Find and use popular software packaged as Helm Charts to run in Kubernetes - Share your own applications as Helm Charts - Create reproducible builds of your Kubernetes applications - Intelligently manage your Kubernetes manifest files - Manage releases of Helm packages Helm in a Handbasket Helm is a tool that streamlines installing and managing Kubernetes applications.
